marta-onboard: quick flag  the new node sample app used by the workshop fails when it tries to pick a quant profile. it calls model metadata from REST but our SDK doesn't return context_size or param_count.

ben-sdk: hmm. which REST path are you using? we removed some metadata fields when we trimmed responses last quarter to reduce payloads.

marta-onboard: `GET /v1/models/llama-mini/metadata`. curl returns:
```
{
  "id": "llama-mini",
  "context_window": 8192,
  "parameter_count": 850000000
}
```
SDK's `client.models.get('llama-mini')` is just `{ id, name }`. the onboarding sample falls back to 4k context and Q4_0 quant which is terrible.

arun-platform: this is related to two production issues we've been tracking: (1) SDK-initiated streaming doesn't attach `x-rw-stream-id` header so our dedicated stream muxer can't route correctly, and (2) the SDK's ephemeral token rotation (default 10m) is shorter than token TTL accepted by our auth service (45m) which leads to stream 401 mid-session when SDK refreshes.

sara-sre: confirmed on a private deployment incident last week. we saw long-running streams drop around the rotation window. also noticed SDK retries are global: it retries 429/500 by default even for non-idempotent admin calls. caused duplicate webhook registrations after a partial success.

ben-sdk: okay action list proposal:
- add `client.models.getMetadata(modelId)` that mirrors REST metadata endpoint (opt-in, not included in `get()` to avoid payload bloat)
- expose `streaming.headers` hook to allow adding `x-rw-stream-id` and any custom routing headers
- make token refresh behavior configurable via env var `REDWOOD_SDK_EPHEMERAL_TTL` and honor provider TTL for private installs
- per-call `retry` config: `retry: { enabled: bool, on: [429,500], retryAfter: true }`

marta-onboard: can we also log a warning when sample app sees a trimmed metadata shape? small note in quickstart would save a lot of confusion for new users.

arun-platform: please include an integ test that simulates token rotation during an open stream and asserts no 401s. and a unit test for streaming header normalization.

sara-sre: for private deploys we should gate `REDWOOD_SDK_EPHEMERAL_TTL` behind an env var check so default hosted behavior doesn't change.

ben-sdk: agree. i'll draft a PR: add `getMetadata`, streaming header hook, and per-call retry knobs. will add tests and a changelog entry highlighting the opt-in metadata endpoint. planning to ship in patch release 0.14.8-canary.

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: CI started for branch feature/sdk-metadata-headers.

marta-onboard: thanks team. i'll update the workshop repo to prefer `getMetadata` if available and include a fallback that emits a clear log and points to the quickstart. this should reduce onboarding tickets.

ben-sdk: thx. ping me the repro snippet and i'll prioritize the fix.
